observation: The Archive added 2025 to its year-by-year Chronology page on 2026-10-04. Its database reports nearly 17,000 information records cross-referenced to more than 2,850 formations, including surveys, nearly 8,000 photographs, contemporaneous reports, scientific research, shadow diagrams and geometry.
change_from_prior_lattice: The provenance corpus is now materially expanded for 2025 and can be mined for source triangulation, geometry, chronology and independently documented formation records.
inference: This is a data-infrastructure upgrade, not evidence that any particular formation has anomalous origin or intentional encoding.
new_test: CCRA-2025-CORPUS-MINING-001: extract 2025 formation identifiers, locations, dates, diagrams, surveys and image references; bind each to source-level provenance; identify formations with multi-source geometry and temporal evidence; convert qualifying cases into frozen CC-OS inputs.
falsifiers: Chronology entries lack source-level identifiers or recoverable imagery.
Geometry cannot be independently reconstructed from the available records.
Dates/locations conflict across primary contemporaneous sources.
